deck_title: Game & Film Character Consistency Pipeline: 3D Pre-Viz (Depth/OpenPose) + Character LoRA / Elements Lock (c_shot = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Per-Shot Text Prompting

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Game & Film Multi-Shot Character Consistency & 3D Camera Pre-Viz pipeline evaluation (conditioning 17 multi-angle storyboard shots on lightweight 3D mannequin Depth/OpenPose passes plus a 4-view Character Turnaround LoRA & IP-Adapter/Kling Elements embedding so amortized per-shot cost c_shot(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_previs = 1.0000x across all 17 shots u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive unconditioned per-shot text prompting (which suffers severe face/costume drift across camera arcs, inflating retake GPU spend by 1 + u to 1.2500x at Shot 4, 1.5000x at Shot 8, and 2.0000x at Shot 16 across 16/17 shots) and 64-bone pose-depth conditioning quadrature.
